title: Robustness of a satellite-derived ecological conclusion
query:
Using the supplied satellite literature and MODIS data, propose and test a hypothesis about how observation coverage changes an inferred ecological relationship or seasonal pattern. Determine whether the conclusion survives a defensible coverage-sensitivity analysis.

Formulate one specific, falsifiable hypothesis before testing it. Define the test, a plausible alternative explanation, and the conditions for rejecting the hypothesis. Report whether the evidence supports, contradicts, or cannot resolve it.
